primary_claim: Clean executions define a privileged physical criticality teacher; a causal student is trained only from clean teacher labels and deployment-facing causal inputs; held-out matched counterfactual interventions then test physical vulnerability without outcome-informed redesign.

C_t.name: clean_physical_criticality
C_t.definition: A clean-derived physical criticality or critical-opportunity label computed from clean state, clean telemetry, clean action history, and registered clean phase semantics only.

V_t(d).name: matched_counterfactual_physical_outcome
V_t(d).definition: A valid physical outcome under a prospectively frozen matched intervention condition and dose d, with CONTROL/T3/T5/T10 conditions and explicit unknown/abstain taxonomy.

E_t.name: visual_exploitability
E_t.definition: A separate visual or policy-input exploitability construct evaluated by a separately authorized VIS protocol.

primary_teacher.name: CLEAN_PRIVILEGED_TEACHER
primary_teacher.semantics: Teacher labels clean-derived physical criticality; they are not ground-truth counterfactual vulnerability labels.
primary_teacher.selection_rule: Teacher protocol and thresholds are frozen before M4 outcomes are read.
primary_teacher.failure_reporting: If clean Teacher coverage, reliability, or semantic validity fails, report the Teacher failure and do not tune it on M4.

primary_student.name: CLEAN_TEACHER_SUPERVISED_CAUSAL_STUDENT
allowed_feature_classes: current observation and short causal history
past action and gripper command/state history
deployment-visible eef motion and object-relative features
forbidden_feature_classes: privileged clean state unavailable at deployment
attack, VIS, PGD, random, oracle, or defense outcomes
future frames, future success, or post-treatment variables
Teacher prediction shortcuts or copied privileged Teacher fields
identity, task, scene, or split leakage
M4 dose or intervention condition as a training feature

held_out_m4.label: V_phys only when the intervention taxonomy is valid; unknown/abstain is not negative.

split_policy.clean_teacher_student: Clean-only train/validation/test identities and clean labels are frozen before any M4 outcome access.
split_policy.m4_parent_exclusion: The final M4 parent manifest must be excluded from FIT, CAL, CHECK, threshold selection, model selection, and any outcome-informed redesign.
split_policy.known_current_set: The present audit covers 29 stable corridor parents plus 7 valid replenishment parents; the final 4 spatial identities remain pending.
split_policy.g10_overlap_rule: G10 identity-level overlap is quarantined as historical held-out registry overlap; its outcomes remain unread and cannot be used as primary evidence without a prospective resolution.
split_policy.unknown_semantics: Unknown or abstained labels remain unknown and are never recoded as negative.

allowed: clean Teacher supervision and clean-only validation
clean-only feature, threshold, and checkpoint decisions before M4 lock
forbidden: using M4 outcomes to revise Teacher semantics
using M4 outcomes to revise Student features or thresholds
model_selection_boundary.lock_event: A complete clean Teacher/Student evidence package and final 40-parent M4 manifest must be sealed before M4 outcomes are read.

planned_m4_analysis.physical_level: Report paired CONTROL/T3/T5/T10 physical outcomes within the frozen critical-opportunity corridor; primary dose is T5.
planned_m4_analysis.teacher_level: Test whether clean Teacher criticality localizes held-out physical vulnerability; do not infer causality from Teacher labels alone.
planned_m4_analysis.student_level: Test whether the frozen causal Student preserves clean-only localization against held-out V_phys.
planned_m4_analysis.negative_controls: Any additional safe/background panel requires a separate prospective protocol before its outcomes are read.
